name: shivmandi-rewrite
description: Modern rebuild of the Shiv Bhole Vegetable (Mandi) ERP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
